name: returning_customer_recall_previous_quote
description: Returning customer asks 'Can I get another quote?' and the AI should recall the previous quote and offer a new one building on prior context.

messages.text: My name is Michael, can I get a quote for 25 sheets of white melamine chipboard 18mm

expected_behaviors.description: AI should address the customer as 'Michael' and reference the previous quote

notes: The customer requests a second quote. The AI should acknowledge the previous quote (white melamine chipboard 18mm) and either offer a revised quote or ask what they would like quoted this time, while addressing them by name.
